== ConLeche/Denotes.lean#L270-L290
   270  structure Model (V : Type w) [SetTheory V] (env : Env) where
   271    /-- the set a constant denotes, per level assignment -/
   272    cval : Name → (LevelParam → Nat) → V
   273    /-- every stored constant is a member of what its type denotes, at
   274    every level assignment (and every variable environment — the type
   275    is closed) -/
   276    mem : ∀ c ∈ env.consts, ∀ (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V),
   277      ∃ T, Denotes cval env φ ρ c.toConstantVal.type T ∧ cval c.name φ ∈ˢ T
   278    /-- whatever the built-in `False` denotes is the empty set -/
   279    false_empty : ∀ (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V) (F : V),
   280      Denotes cval env φ ρ (.const falseName []) F → F = empty
   281    /-- whatever the built-in `Eq` denotes is set equality: at a type `A`
   282    of the universe the level `u` names, and two of its members `a` and
   283    `b`, `@Eq.{u} A a b` denotes the truth value of `a = b`.  The three
   284    membership premises are the graph's domains — `Eq`'s denotation is a
   285    three-fold graph over `univ (Level.eval φ u)`, then over `A`, then
   286    over `A` again, and a graph read off its domain says nothing -/
   287    eq_equality : ∀ (u : Level) (φ : LevelParam → Nat) (ρ : BVarIdx → V) (E A a b : V),
   288      Denotes cval env φ ρ (.const eqName [u]) E →
   289      A ∈ˢ univ (Level.eval φ u) → a ∈ˢ A → b ∈ˢ A →
   290      app (app (app E A) a) b = eqv a b

== ConLeche/Semantics/Interp.lean#L150-L160
   150  noncomputable def interp : (Nat → V) → AnnotTerm → V
   151    | ρ, .bvar i => ρ i
   152    | _, .sort u => univ u
   153    | _, .const c us => bval V c us
   154    | ρ, .app f a => SetTheory.app (interp ρ f) (interp ρ a)
   155    | ρ, .lam v A b => lamR v (interp ρ A) fun x => interp (cons x ρ) b
   156    | ρ, .pi _ v A B => piR v (interp ρ A) fun x => interp (cons x ρ) B
   157    | ρ, .eqE a b => eqv (interp ρ a) (interp ρ b)
   158    | ρ, .fst e => sfst (interp ρ e)
   159    | ρ, .snd e => ssnd (interp ρ e)
   160    | _, .prf => pt

== ConLeche/Semantics/WellDenoted.lean#L81-L95
    81  def WellDenoted : (Nat → V) → AnnotTerm → Prop
    82    | ρ, .pi _u _v A B =>
    83      WellDenoted ρ A ∧
    84      ∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → WellDenoted (cons x ρ) B
    85    | ρ, .lam v A b =>
    86      WellDenoted ρ A ∧
    87      (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → WellDenoted (cons x ρ) b) ∧
    88      ∃ B : V → V,
    89        (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → interp V (cons x ρ) b ∈ˢ B x) ∧
    90        (v = 0 → ∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → B x ∈ˢ (univZero : V))
    91    | ρ, .app f a =>
    92      WellDenoted ρ f ∧ WellDenoted ρ a ∧
    93      ∃ (v : Nat) (A : V) (B : V → V),
    94        interp V ρ f ∈ˢ piR v A B ∧ interp V ρ a ∈ˢ A ∧
    95        (v = 0 → ∀ x, x ∈ˢ A → B x ∈ˢ (univZero : V))

    31  inductive Expr where
    32    /-- A bound variable, by de Bruijn index. -/
    33    | bvar (i : Nat)
    34    /-- The sort `Sort l`. -/
    35    | sort (l : Level)

    43    /-- The dependent product `(x : A) → B`, annotated with when `B` is a

    45    | pi (A : Expr) (pw : PropWhen) (B : Expr)
    46    deriving DecidableEq

== whitepaper/Fragment/PropWhen.lean#L176-L194
   176  /-- **When a binder's body is a proposition**: never, or exactly at the
   177  valuations where every parameter of the set is zero.  (`whenZero ∅` is
   178  "always".) -/
   179  inductive PropWhen where
   180    /-- The body is never a proposition — the *graph regime*, where the
   181    β rule needs no certificate (`Red.betaGate`). -/
   182    | never
   183    /-- The body is a proposition exactly when these level parameters
   184    are all zero. -/
   185    | whenZero (ps : ParamSet)
   186    deriving DecidableEq
   187  
   188  namespace PropWhen
   189  
   190  /-- The readout at a valuation: is the body a proposition here? -/
   191  def holds (pw : PropWhen) (φ : Name → Nat) : Bool :=
   192    match pw with
   193    | never => false
   194    | whenZero ps => ps.list.all fun n => φ n == 0

   414    private ofRepr ::
   415    private repr : PropWhenRepr

== ConLeche/Kernel/PropWhen.lean#L694-L700
   694  def holds (φ : Name → Nat) (pw : PropWhen) : Bool :=
   695    match pw.repr with
   696    | .never => false
   697    | .always => true
   698    | .one p => φ p == 0
   699    | .two p q _ => (φ p == 0) && (φ q == 0)
   700    | .many ps _ => ps.all fun n => φ n == 0

   233  at every valuation.  So the checker compares annotations with `=`, and
   234  that comparison is semantic. -/
   235  theorem eq_iff (a b : PropWhen) : a = b ↔ ∀ φ : Name → Nat, holds a φ = holds b φ := by

== whitepaper/Fragment/Syntax.lean#L62-L71
    62  /-- Instantiate the bound variable `k` by `a` (and lower the indices
    63  above it): `e.inst a` is `e[x := a]` for the innermost binder. -/
    64  def inst : Expr → Expr → (k : Nat := 0) → Expr
    65    | bvar i, a, k =>
    66      if i < k then bvar i else if i = k then liftN k a else bvar (i - 1)
    67    | sort u, _, _ => sort u
    68    | const c ls, _, _ => const c ls
    69    | app f b, a, k => app (inst f a k) (inst b a k)
    70    | lam A pw b, a, k => lam (inst A a k) pw (inst b a (k + 1))
    71    | pi A pw B, a, k => pi (inst A a k) pw (inst B a (k + 1))

== ConLeche/Kernel/ExprOps.lean#L33-L45
    33  def instantiate1 (e : Expr) (v : Expr) (d : Nat := 0) : Expr :=
    34    match e with
    35    | .bvar i => if i = d then v else if i > d then .bvar (i - 1) else .bvar i
    36    | .fvar idx ty => .fvar idx ty
    37    | .sort u => .sort u
    38    | .const n us => .const n us
    39    | .app f a => .app (instantiate1 f v d) (instantiate1 a v d)
    40    | .lam ty body bi => .lam (instantiate1 ty v d) (instantiate1 body v (d + 1)) bi
    41    | .forallE ty body bi => .forallE (instantiate1 ty v d) (instantiate1 body v (d + 1)) bi
    42    | .letE ty val body =>
    43      .letE (instantiate1 ty v d) (instantiate1 val v d) (instantiate1 body v (d + 1))
    44    | .lit l => .lit l
    45    | .proj s i e => .proj s i (instantiate1 e v d)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Syntax.lean#L104-L112
   104  /-- Instantiate the level parameters `ps` at the levels `ls`, in
   105  sorts, constants and annotations. -/
   106  def instL (ps : List Name) (ls : List Level) : Expr → Expr
   107    | bvar i => bvar i
   108    | sort u => sort (u.subst ps ls)
   109    | const c us => const c (us.map (Level.subst ps ls))
   110    | app f a => app (instL ps ls f) (instL ps ls a)
   111    | lam A pw b => lam (instL ps ls A) (pw.substL ps ls) (instL ps ls b)
   112    | pi A pw B => pi (instL ps ls A) (pw.substL ps ls) (instL ps ls B)

== whitepaper/Fragment/PropWhen.lean#L322-L329
   322  /-- **Level substitution on a datum**: instantiating the declaration's
   323  parameters `ps` at levels `ls`, "all of `qs` zero" becomes "each
   324  substitute of a `q ∈ qs` zero" — the conjunction of the substitutes'
   325  zero-ness data.  Mirrors `Level.substPW` (`ConLeche/Kernel/Level.lean`). -/
   326  def substL (ps : List Name) (ls : List Level) : PropWhen → PropWhen
   327    | never => never
   328    | whenZero qs =>
   329      qs.list.foldr (fun q acc => (Level.zeroness (Level.lookupLevel ps ls q)).inter acc) always

== ConLeche/Kernel/Level.lean#L234-L245
   234  def Expr.instantiateLevelParams (ks : List Name) (us : List Level) : Expr → Expr
   235    | .bvar i => .bvar i
   236    | .fvar idx ty => .fvar idx (ty.instantiateLevelParams ks us)
   237    | .sort u => .sort (Level.subst ks us u)
   238    | .const n vs => .const n (vs.map (Level.subst ks us))
   239    | .app f a => .app (f.instantiateLevelParams ks us) (a.instantiateLevelParams ks us)
   240    | .lam ty body m =>
   241      .lam (ty.instantiateLevelParams ks us) (body.instantiateLevelParams ks us)
   242        ⟨Level.substPW ks us m.pw⟩
   243    | .forallE ty body m =>
   244      .forallE (ty.instantiateLevelParams ks us) (body.instantiateLevelParams ks us)
   245        ⟨Level.substPW ks us m.pw⟩

== ConLeche/Kernel/Level.lean#L205-L207
   205  def substPW (ks : List Name) (vs : List Level) (pw : PropWhen) :
   206      PropWhen :=
   207    pw.bindZ fun n => zeronessOf (subst.go ks vs n)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Level.lean#L32-L46
    32  /-- Universe levels (`Lean.Level` without `mvar`). -/
    33  inductive Level where
    34    /-- `Prop`'s level, `0`. -/
    35    | zero
    36    /-- The successor level `u + 1`. -/
    37    | succ (l : Level)
    38    /-- The maximum `max u v`. -/
    39    | max (a b : Level)
    40    /-- The impredicative maximum: `imax u v` is `0` when `v` is `0`,
    41    else `max u v` — so a `∀` whose codomain is a proposition is a
    42    proposition whatever its domain's level. -/
    43    | imax (a b : Level)
    44    /-- A level parameter of the enclosing declaration. -/
    45    | param (n : Name)
    46    deriving DecidableEq, Repr

== ConLeche/Kernel/Expr.lean#L41-L46
    41  inductive Level where
    42    | zero
    43    | succ (u : Level)
    44    | max (u v : Level)
    45    | imax (u v : Level)
    46    | param (n : Name)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Level.lean#L53-L59
    53  /-- The value of a level under a *valuation* `φ` of its parameters. -/
    54  def eval (φ : Name → Nat) : Level → Nat
    55    | zero => 0
    56    | succ l => eval φ l + 1
    57    | max a b => Max.max (eval φ a) (eval φ b)
    58    | imax a b => imaxNat (eval φ a) (eval φ b)
    59    | param n => φ n

== ConLeche/Verify/Level.lean#L26-L31
    26  @[expose] def eval (φ : Name → Nat) : Level → Nat
    27    | .zero => 0
    28    | .succ l => eval φ l + 1
    29    | .max l r => Max.max (eval φ l) (eval φ r)
    30    | .imax l r => if eval φ r = 0 then 0 else Max.max (eval φ l) (eval φ r)
    31    | .param n => φ n

== whitepaper/Fragment/Level.lean#L117-L130
   117  /-- **The level oracle** — the checker's decision procedures for `≤` and
   118  `=` on levels, assumed sound and complete with respect to `eval`: a
   119  parameter of the development, never defined here.  (`le` is what the
   120  inductive installs of the environment section consume; the env-free
   121  fragment uses `eq` alone.) -/
   122  class LevelOracle where
   123    /-- `le u v = true` decides `u ≤ v` at every valuation. -/
   124    le : Level → Level → Bool
   125    /-- `eq u v = true` decides `u = v` at every valuation. -/
   126    eq : Level → Level → Bool
   127    /-- Soundness and completeness of `le`. -/
   128    le_iff : ∀ a b : Level, le a b = true ↔ ∀ φ : Name → Nat, Level.eval φ a ≤ Level.eval φ b
   129    /-- Soundness and completeness of `eq`. -/
   130    eq_iff : ∀ a b : Level, eq a b = true ↔ ∀ φ : Name → Nat, Level.eval φ a = Level.eval φ b

== ConLeche/Kernel/Level.lean#L138-L140
   138  /-- Decide `l ≤ r` semantically; `none` is an internal error. -/
   139  def leq (l r : Level) : Option Bool :=
   140    leqCore defaultFuel (simplify l) (simplify r) 0

== ConLeche/Kernel/Level.lean#L158-L161
   158  def isEquiv (l r : Level) : Option Bool := do
   159    if l == r then pure true
   160    else if simplify l = simplify r then pure true
   161    else if ← leq l r then leq r l else pure false

== whitepaper/Fragment/PropWhen.lean#L208-L212
   208  /-- The conjunction of two data: a proposition when both are. -/
   209  def inter : PropWhen → PropWhen → PropWhen
   210    | never, _ => never
   211    | _, never => never
   212    | whenZero s, whenZero t => whenZero (s.union t)

== ConLeche/Kernel/PropWhen.lean#L866

== whitepaper/Fragment/PropWhen.lean#L279-L302
   279  /-- **The zero-ness datum of a level**: the reading of `{φ | eval φ l = 0}`.
   280  A `succ` is never zero; a `max` is zero when both sides are; an `imax`
   281  is zero exactly when its second argument is (`imaxNat_eq_zero_iff`).
   282  Mirrors `Level.zeronessOf` (`ConLeche/Kernel/Level.lean`). -/
   283  def zeroness : Level → PropWhen
   284    | zero => .always
   285    | succ _ => .never
   286    | param n => .whenZero (ParamSet.single n)
   287    | max a b => (zeroness a).inter (zeroness b)
   288    | imax _ b => zeroness b
   289  
   290  /-- **Exactness**: the datum reads `true` exactly where the level
   291  evaluates to zero. -/
   292  theorem holds_zeroness (φ : Name → Nat) : ∀ l : Level,
   293      (zeroness l).holds φ = true ↔ eval φ l = 0
   294    | zero => by simp [zeroness]
   295    | succ l => by simp [zeroness]
   296    | param n => by simp [zeroness, PropWhen.holds_whenZero]
   297    | max a b => by
   298      simp only [zeroness, PropWhen.holds_inter, Bool.and_eq_true, holds_zeroness φ a,
   299        holds_zeroness φ b, eval_max]
   300      omega
   301    | imax a b => by
   302      simp only [zeroness, holds_zeroness φ b, eval_imax, imaxNat_eq_zero_iff]

== ConLeche/Kernel/Level.lean#L190-L195
   190  def zeronessOf : Level → PropWhen
   191    | .zero => .ifAllZero []
   192    | .succ _ => .never
   193    | .param n => .ifAllZero [n]
   194    | .max a b => (zeronessOf a).inter (zeronessOf b)
   195    | .imax _ b => zeronessOf b

== ConLeche/Verify/PropWhen.lean#L52-L53
    52  theorem zeronessOf_sound (φ : Name → Nat) :
    53      ∀ l : Level, (Level.zeronessOf l).holds φ = (Level.eval φ l == 0)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Rules.lean#L46-L278
    46  mutual
    47  
    48  /-- **Reduction**: the head steps of the checker's `whnf`, chained. -/
    49  inductive Red (env : Env) : List Expr → Expr → Expr → Prop where
    50    /-- No step (`Red.refl`, `Rel.lean:101`). -/
    51    | refl {Γ : List Expr} {e : Expr} : Red env Γ e e
    52    /-- Chaining (`Red.trans`, `Rel.lean:106`).  A reduction is a
    53    denotation identity, so chaining costs nothing semantically. -/
    54    | trans {Γ : List Expr} {e₁ e₂ e₃ : Expr} :
    55        Red env Γ e₁ e₂ → Red env Γ e₂ e₃ → Red env Γ e₁ e₃
    56    /-- Head reduction inside an application (`Red.appFn`,
    57    `Rel.lean:111`): the head is reduced before a redex is looked for. -/
    58    | appFn {Γ : List Expr} {f f' a : Expr} :
    59        Red env Γ f f' → Red env Γ (app f a) (app f' a)
    60    /-- **β at a fired gate** (`Red.betaGate`, `Rel.lean:121`): a λ whose
    61    annotation is `never` — its body is never a proposition — reduces
    62    with NO certificate.  The soundness of this step is the *graph
    63    regime*'s β: an application that is well-denoted applies a graph to
    64    a member of its domain, and a graph determines its domain
    65    (`Sound.lean`, `red_sound`'s `betaGate` case). -/
    66    | betaGate {Γ : List Expr} {A b a : Expr} :
    67        Red env Γ (app (lam A .never b) a) (b.inst a)
    68    /-- **β, certified** (`Red.beta`, `Rel.lean:126`): at any annotation,
    69    the argument's inferred type is definitionally equal to the domain.
    70    This is the check the real checker runs where the body may be a
    71    proposition, because then the model cannot recover the domain from
    72    the function's value (DESIGN.md, "Beta soundness without subject
    73    reduction"). -/
    74    | beta {Γ : List Expr} {A b a ta : Expr} {pw : PropWhen} :
    75        Infer env Γ a ta → DefEq env Γ ta A →
    76        Red env Γ (app (lam A pw b) a) (b.inst a)
    77    /-- **δ** (`Red.delta`, `Rel.lean:132`): a definition unfolds to its
    78    value, at the use's level instantiation.  (With `appFn`, an applied
    79    definition unfolds at its head.) -/
    80    | delta {Γ : List Expr} {c : Name} {ls : List Level} {ci : ConstInfo} {v : Expr} :
    81        env.find? c = some ci → ci.value? = some v →
    82        ls.length = ci.lparams.length →
    83        Red env Γ (const c ls) (v.instL ci.lparams ls)
    84    /-- **ι** (`Red.iota`, `Rel.lean:184`): a stored recursor applied to
    85    exactly its telescope — `numParams` parameters, `numMotives` motives,
    86    `numMinors` minor premises, `numIndices` indices and the major
    87    premise — whose major reduces to a constructor application with a
    88    rule, fires the rule: the rule's right-hand side, at the use's
    89    levels, applied to the parameters, motives and minors, then to the
    90    constructor's fields (its arguments after the parameters).
    91  
    92    The two **telescope certificates** are `Rel.lean`'s `Certs` walks
    93    (`:576-587`) folded in: the recursor's argument spine (with the
    94    reduced major) and the constructor's argument spine are each typed
    95    against the stored type's `Π`-telescope — every argument's type is
    96    inferred and found definitionally equal to the binder domain it
    97    meets (`Expr.piDomains`), and the stored type has the spine's
    98    length of syntactic binders (`Expr.hasPis`; a generated type does).
    99    They are what makes the environment's ι law (`EnvModel.lean`,
   100    `RecRuleLaw`) applicable: they put every argument in its domain.
   101  
   102    The **three comparisons** after them are `Rel.lean`'s too
   103    (`:206-231`): the constructor's levels are the recursor's (its last
   104    `usj.length` ones — a large eliminator carries one extra level in
   105    front), the constructor's parameters are definitionally the
   106    recursor's, and the constructor's residual type
   107    (`Expr.piResidual`: the family at the constructor's own parameters
   108    and index expressions, with the fields substituted in) has index
   109    expressions definitionally equal to the recursor's index arguments.
   110    In the model they matter exactly when the family is a proposition:
   111    there the major denotes the one point, the certificates say only
   112    that the fibre is inhabited, and the fields the rule's right-hand
   113    side receives can be related to the recursor's own parameters and
   114    indices through these comparisons alone (`Install.lean`). -/
   115    | iota {Γ : List Expr} {c : Name} {us : List Level} {ci : ConstInfo}
   116        {numParams numMotives numMinors numIndices : Nat} {rules : List RecRule}
   117        {args : List Expr} {major : Expr} {cj : Name} {usj : List Level}
   118        {cij : ConstInfo} {margs : List Expr} {rl : RecRule}
   119        {doms tys doms' tys' : List Expr}
   120        {residual : Expr} {I : Name} {lsI : List Level} {rps ridx : List Expr} :
   121        env.find? c = some ci →
   122        ci.kind = .recursor numParams numMotives numMinors numIndices rules →
   123        us.length = ci.lparams.length →
   124        args.length = numParams + numMotives + numMinors + numIndices + 1 →
   125        ci.type.hasPis (numParams + numMotives + numMinors + numIndices + 1) = true →
   126        Red env Γ (args.getD (numParams + numMotives + numMinors + numIndices) (bvar 0))
   127          major →
   128        major = mkAppN (const cj usj) margs →
   129        rl ∈ rules → rl.ctor = cj →
   130        env.find? cj = some cij →
   131        usj.length = cij.lparams.length →
   132        margs.length = numParams + rl.nfields →
   133        cij.type.hasPis (numParams + rl.nfields) = true →
   134        -- the recursor's telescope certificate, on the spine with the reduced major
   135        piDomains (ci.type.instL ci.lparams us)
   136          (args.take (numParams + numMotives + numMinors + numIndices) ++ [major]) = some doms →
   137        tys.length = doms.length →
   138        (∀ p ∈ (args.take (numParams + numMotives + numMinors + numIndices) ++ [major]).zip tys,
   139          Infer env Γ p.1 p.2) →
   140        (∀ p ∈ tys.zip doms, DefEq env Γ p.1 p.2) →
   141        -- the constructor's telescope certificate
   142        piDomains (cij.type.instL cij.lparams usj) margs = some doms' →
   143        tys'.length = doms'.length →
   144        (∀ p ∈ margs.zip tys', Infer env Γ p.1 p.2) →
   145        (∀ p ∈ tys'.zip doms', DefEq env Γ p.1 p.2) →
   146        -- the constructor's levels, parameters and residual indices against the recursor's
   147        Level.eqList usj (us.drop (us.length - usj.length)) = true →
   148        (∀ p ∈ (margs.take numParams).zip (args.take numParams), DefEq env Γ p.1 p.2) →
   149        piResidual (cij.type.instL cij.lparams usj) margs = some residual →
   150        residual = mkAppN (const I lsI) (rps ++ ridx) →
   151        rps.length = numParams →
   152        (∀ p ∈ ridx.zip ((args.take (numParams + numMotives + numMinors + numIndices)).drop
   153          (numParams + numMotives + numMinors)), DefEq env Γ p.1 p.2) →
   154        Red env Γ (mkAppN (const c us) args)
   155          (mkAppN (rl.rhs.instL ci.lparams us)
   156            (args.take (numParams + numMotives + numMinors) ++ margs.drop numParams))
   157  
   158  /-- **Definitional equality**: the verdict `true` of the checker's
   159  `isDefEq`.
   160  
   161  **There is no `trans` rule, deliberately** (`Rel.lean:310-333`, task
   162  #309).  The relation is the checker's verdict on two terms that are
   163  well-formed *together*, a fact no rule states because well-formedness
   164  is semantic (`WellDenoted`) and may not enter this inductive.  Every
   165  rule respects one discipline instead: **the subject of each `DefEq`
   166  premise is a subterm of the conclusion or is produced by a `Red` or
   167  `Infer` premise** (a reduct, an inferred type), so the soundness proof
   168  always has the premise's terms — and their invariant — in hand.  A
   169  `trans` rule is the unique rule that would break it: its middle term
   170  comes from nowhere, so nothing supplies its invariant, and the
   171  induction has nothing to apply the hypothesis to.  In the real checker
   172  the rule is not merely unprovable but unsound (`fvar`s carry
   173  annotations `DefEq.fvar` does not compare while `DefEq.proofFast`
   174  reads; `trans` lets the two meet).  The one sound chaining is "reduce,
   175  then continue": `redL`. -/
   176  inductive DefEq (env : Env) : List Expr → Expr → Expr → Prop where
   177    /-- The syntactic fast path (`DefEq.refl`, `Rel.lean:338`). -/
   178    | refl {Γ : List Expr} {a : Expr} : DefEq env Γ a a
   179    /-- Symmetry (`DefEq.symm`, `Rel.lean:341`).  Not a checker move: the
   180    constructor from which every right-hand variant of a one-sided rule
   181    is derived. -/
   182    | symm {Γ : List Expr} {a b : Expr} : DefEq env Γ a b → DefEq env Γ b a
   183    /-- **Reduce the left side, then continue** (`DefEq.redL`,
   184    `Rel.lean:346`): the recursive structure of `isDefEq` — head
   185    normalisation of either side (with `symm`) and every lazy-δ
   186    continuation. -/
   187    | redL {Γ : List Expr} {a a' b : Expr} :
   188        Red env Γ a a' → DefEq env Γ a' b → DefEq env Γ a b
   189    /-- Two sorts, by the level oracle (`DefEq.sort`, `Rel.lean:349`). -/
   190    | sort {Γ : List Expr} {u v : Level} :
   191        LevelOracle.eq u v = true → DefEq env Γ (sort u) (sort v)
   192    /-- Two constants of the same name at oracle-equal levels
   193    (`DefEq.const`, `Rel.lean:360`). -/
   194    | const {Γ : List Expr} {c : Name} {ls ls' : List Level} :
   195        Level.eqList ls ls' = true → DefEq env Γ (const c ls) (const c ls')
   196    /-- `∀`-congruence (`DefEq.forallE`, `Rel.lean:373`): domains, then
   197    bodies under the RIGHT domain, and the annotations must agree (they
   198    are compared with `=`, which is semantic: `PropWhen.eq_iff`). -/
   199    | pi {Γ : List Expr} {A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ : Expr} {pw : PropWhen} :
   200        DefEq env Γ A₁ A₂ → DefEq env (A₂ :: Γ) B₁ B₂ →
   201        DefEq env Γ (pi A₁ pw B₁) (pi A₂ pw B₂)
   202    /-- λ-congruence (`DefEq.lam`, `Rel.lean:380`), as for `∀`. -/
   203    | lam {Γ : List Expr} {A₁ b₁ A₂ b₂ : Expr} {pw : PropWhen} :
   204        DefEq env Γ A₁ A₂ → DefEq env (A₂ :: Γ) b₁ b₂ →
   205        DefEq env Γ (lam A₁ pw b₁) (lam A₂ pw b₂)
   206    /-- Application congruence (`DefEq.app`, `Rel.lean:390`). -/
   207    | app {Γ : List Expr} {f₁ a₁ f₂ a₂ : Expr} :
   208        DefEq env Γ f₁ f₂ → DefEq env Γ a₁ a₂ →
   209        DefEq env Γ (app f₁ a₁) (app f₂ a₂)
   210    /-- **η** (`DefEq.eta`, `Rel.lean:400`): a λ against a term `b`
   211    whose inferred type reduces to a `∀` with a definitionally equal
   212    domain and the same annotation, when the λ's body is `b` applied to
   213    the variable.  Sound because a member of a function space is the
   214    abstraction of its applications (`SetLib.graph_app_eq`) — and at a
   215    proposition both sides are the one proof. -/
   216    | eta {Γ : List Expr} {A₁ b₁ b tb A₂ B : Expr} {pw : PropWhen} :
   217        Infer env Γ b tb → Red env Γ tb (pi A₂ pw B) →
   218        DefEq env Γ A₂ A₁ →
   219        DefEq env (A₁ :: Γ) b₁ (app (b.liftN 1) (bvar 0)) →
   220        DefEq env Γ (lam A₁ pw b₁) b
   221    /-- **Proof irrelevance** (`DefEq.proofIrrel`, `Rel.lean:417`): both
   222    sides' inferred types have sort `Prop`.  **The two types are never
   223    compared**: the model licenses that, because every proof denotes the
   224    one point. -/
   225    | proofIrrel {Γ : List Expr} {a ta tta b tb ttb : Expr} {u v : Level} :
   226        Infer env Γ a ta → Infer env Γ ta tta → Red env Γ tta (sort u) →
   227        LevelOracle.eq u .zero = true →
   228        Infer env Γ b tb → Infer env Γ tb ttb → Red env Γ ttb (sort v) →
   229        LevelOracle.eq v .zero = true →
   230        DefEq env Γ a b
   231  
   232  /-- **Type inference.** -/
   233  inductive Infer (env : Env) : List Expr → Expr → Expr → Prop where
   234    /-- A bound variable's type is its context entry, lifted over the
   235    binders in between (`Infer.fvar`, `Rel.lean:492`; the real checker
   236    reads the type off the free variable). -/
   237    | bvar {Γ : List Expr} {i : Nat} {A : Expr} :
   238        Γ[i]? = some A → Infer env Γ (bvar i) (A.liftN (i + 1))
   239    /-- `Sort u : Sort (u + 1)` (`Infer.sort`, `Rel.lean:488`). -/
   240    | sort {Γ : List Expr} {u : Level} :
   241        Infer env Γ (sort u) (sort (.succ u))
   242    /-- A stored constant at the right number of levels has its
   243    declared type, instantiated (`Infer.const`, `Rel.lean:496`). -/
   244    | const {Γ : List Expr} {c : Name} {ls : List Level} {ci : ConstInfo} :
   245        env.find? c = some ci → ls.length = ci.lparams.length →
   246        Infer env Γ (const c ls) (ci.type.instL ci.lparams ls)
   247    /-- **`∀`-formation** (`Infer.forallE`, `Rel.lean:515`): the domain's
   248    type reduces to a sort `u`, the body's type (under the domain)
   249    reduces to a sort `v`, the result is `Sort (imax u v)` — and **the
   250    annotation is checked**: it must be the zero-ness datum of `v`. -/
   251    | pi {Γ : List Expr} {A B s t : Expr} {u v : Level} {pw : PropWhen} :
   252        Infer env Γ A s → Red env Γ s (sort u) →
   253        Infer env (A :: Γ) B t → Red env (A :: Γ) t (sort v) →
   254        Level.zeroness v = pw →
   255        Infer env Γ (pi A pw B) (sort (.imax u v))
   256    /-- **λ** (`Infer.lam`, `Rel.lean:530`): the domain's type reduces to
   257    a sort, the body is inferred under the domain, the body's type has a
   258    sort `v`, and **the annotation is checked** against `v`.  (The real
   259    checker validates the datum once per λ-chain; the fragment does it
   260    at every λ.) -/
   261    | lam {Γ : List Expr} {A b s bt btt : Expr} {u v : Level} {pw : PropWhen} :
   262        Infer env Γ A s → Red env Γ s (sort u) →
   263        Infer env (A :: Γ) b bt →
   264        Infer env (A :: Γ) bt btt → Red env (A :: Γ) btt (sort v) →
   265        Level.zeroness v = pw →
   266        Infer env Γ (lam A pw b) (pi A pw bt)
   267    /-- **Application** (`Infer.app`, `Rel.lean:544`): the head's type
   268    reduces to a `∀`, and the argument's inferred type is definitionally
   269    equal to its domain.  This is where a syntactic proof would need
   270    Π-injectivity and the semantic one does not: the `∀` the head's type
   271    reduces to *is* a function space, and membership in it is what the
   272    model needs (`Sound.lean`, `infer_sound`'s `app` case). -/
   273    | app {Γ : List Expr} {f a tf A B ta : Expr} {pw : PropWhen} :
   274        Infer env Γ f tf → Red env Γ tf (pi A pw B) →
   275        Infer env Γ a ta → DefEq env Γ ta A →
   276        Infer env Γ (app f a) (B.inst a)
   277  
   278  end

    94  /-- **Reduction**: the head steps of `whnfCore` and the `whnf` loop,
    95  chained. -/
    96  inductive Red (env : Env) : Nat → Expr → Expr → Prop where

== whitepaper/Fragment/Rules.lean#L48-L59
    48  /-- **Reduction**: the head steps of the checker's `whnf`, chained. -/
    49  inductive Red (env : Env) : List Expr → Expr → Expr → Prop where
    50    /-- No step (`Red.refl`, `Rel.lean:101`). -/
    51    | refl {Γ : List Expr} {e : Expr} : Red env Γ e e
    52    /-- Chaining (`Red.trans`, `Rel.lean:106`).  A reduction is a
    53    denotation identity, so chaining costs nothing semantically. -/
    54    | trans {Γ : List Expr} {e₁ e₂ e₃ : Expr} :
    55        Red env Γ e₁ e₂ → Red env Γ e₂ e₃ → Red env Γ e₁ e₃
    56    /-- Head reduction inside an application (`Red.appFn`,
    57    `Rel.lean:111`): the head is reduced before a redex is looked for. -/
    58    | appFn {Γ : List Expr} {f f' a : Expr} :
    59        Red env Γ f f' → Red env Γ (app f a) (app f' a)

== ConLeche/Rules/Rel.lean#L96-L112
    96  inductive Red (env : Env) : Nat → Expr → Expr → Prop where
    97    /-- Every `pure e` exit: the value clauses of `whnfCoreBody`
    98    (`Core.lean:970-975`), the stuck fallbacks (`:1003`, `:1033-1035`),
    99    an uncertified redex (`:1001`), `iotaRec = none` (`:1003`), the
   100    loop's fixpoint (`whnfStep`'s `pure e₁`, `:1088`). -/
   101    | refl {d : Nat} {e : Expr} : Red env d e e
   102    /-- The recursive `whnfCore` continuations after β/ι/proj
   103    (`Core.lean:990`, `:997`, `:1002`, `:1033`), the `whnf` loop
   104    (`whnfLoop`, `:1091-1095`), and the major's preparation chain
   105    (`prepareMajor`, `:785-807`). -/
   106    | trans {d : Nat} {e₁ e₂ e₃ : Expr} :
   107        Red env d e₁ e₂ → Red env d e₂ e₃ → Red env d e₁ e₃
   108    /-- Head normalisation inside an application (`whnfCoreBody`'s
   109    `.app` clause, `Core.lean:976-977`: `whnfCore f` before the redex
   110    tests). -/
   111    | appFn {d : Nat} {f f' a : Expr} :
   112        Red env d f f' → Red env d (.app f a) (.app f' a)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Rules.lean#L60-L76
    60    /-- **β at a fired gate** (`Red.betaGate`, `Rel.lean:121`): a λ whose
    61    annotation is `never` — its body is never a proposition — reduces
    62    with NO certificate.  The soundness of this step is the *graph
    63    regime*'s β: an application that is well-denoted applies a graph to
    64    a member of its domain, and a graph determines its domain
    65    (`Sound.lean`, `red_sound`'s `betaGate` case). -/
    66    | betaGate {Γ : List Expr} {A b a : Expr} :
    67        Red env Γ (app (lam A .never b) a) (b.inst a)
    68    /-- **β, certified** (`Red.beta`, `Rel.lean:126`): at any annotation,
    69    the argument's inferred type is definitionally equal to the domain.
    70    This is the check the real checker runs where the body may be a
    71    proposition, because then the model cannot recover the domain from
    72    the function's value (DESIGN.md, "Beta soundness without subject
    73    reduction"). -/
    74    | beta {Γ : List Expr} {A b a ta : Expr} {pw : PropWhen} :
    75        Infer env Γ a ta → DefEq env Γ ta A →
    76        Red env Γ (app (lam A pw b) a) (b.inst a)

== ConLeche/Rules/Rel.lean#L121-L128
   121    | betaGate {d : Nat} {ty body a : Expr} {mb : BinderMeta} :
   122        mb.pw.isNever = true →
   123        Red env d (.app (.lam ty body mb) a) (body.instantiate1 a)
   124    /-- **β, certified** (`Core.lean:996-998`): the argument's io-grade
   125    type is definitionally equal to the domain. -/
   126    | beta {d : Nat} {ty body a ta : Expr} {mb : BinderMeta} :
   127        Infer env .io d a ta → DefEq env d ta ty →
   128        Red env d (.app (.lam ty body mb) a) (body.instantiate1 a)

== ConLeche/Rules/Rel.lean#L334-L362
   334  inductive DefEq (env : Env) : Nat → Expr → Expr → Prop where
   335    /-- The syntactic fast paths (`defeqStep`, `Core.lean:1463`, `:1472`),
   336    the literal leaf (`:1582`), a same-index `fvar` pair is `fvar`
   337    below. -/
   338    | refl {d : Nat} {a : Expr} : DefEq env d a a
   339    /-- Symmetry.  Not a checker move: the constructor from which every
   340    right-hand-side variant of a one-sided rule is derived. -/
   341    | symm {d : Nat} {a b : Expr} : DefEq env d a b → DefEq env d b a
   342    /-- **Reduce the left side, then continue** — the recursive-structure
   343    rule (ruling 1).  Covers `whnfCore` of both sides (`Core.lean:1466-1467`,
   344    with `symm`), literal acceleration (`:1517-1529`), every lazy-delta
   345    continuation (`:1537-1577`), and the string-literal expansion. -/
   346    | redL {d : Nat} {a a' b : Expr} :
   347        Red env d a a' → DefEq env d a' b → DefEq env d a b
   348    /-- Two sorts (`Core.lean:1581`). -/
   349    | sort {d : Nat} {u v : Level} :
   350        Level.isEquiv u v = some true → DefEq env d (.sort u) (.sort v)
   351    /-- Two free variables of the same index (`Core.lean:1618-1620`).  The
   352    annotations are NOT compared, as the checker does not compare them:
   353    at a well-formed call `CtxOk` pins every opened variable's
   354    annotation, so the reading ignores them.  This is one half of why
   355    the relation has no `trans` (see the inductive's docstring). -/
   356    | fvar {d i : Nat} {ty₁ ty₂ : Expr} :
   357        DefEq env d (.fvar i ty₁) (.fvar i ty₂)
   358    /-- Two constants of the same name at equivalent levels
   359    (`Core.lean:1621-1626`). -/
   360    | const {d : Nat} {n : Name} {us us' : List Level} :
   361        Level.isEquivList us us' = some true →
   362        DefEq env d (.const n us) (.const n us')

== whitepaper/Fragment/Rules.lean#L196-L209
   196    /-- `∀`-congruence (`DefEq.forallE`, `Rel.lean:373`): domains, then

   199    | pi {Γ : List Expr} {A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ : Expr} {pw : PropWhen} :
   200        DefEq env Γ A₁ A₂ → DefEq env (A₂ :: Γ) B₁ B₂ →
   201        DefEq env Γ (pi A₁ pw B₁) (pi A₂ pw B₂)

   204        DefEq env Γ A₁ A₂ → DefEq env (A₂ :: Γ) b₁ b₂ →
   205        DefEq env Γ (lam A₁ pw b₁) (lam A₂ pw b₂)

   373    | forallE {d : Nat} {ty₁ body₁ ty₂ body₂ : Expr} {m₁ m₂ : BinderMeta} :
   374        DefEq env d ty₁ ty₂ →
   375        DefEq env (d + 1) (body₁.instantiate1 (.fvar d ty₂))
   376          (body₂.instantiate1 (.fvar d ty₂)) →
   377        m₁.pw = m₂.pw →
   378        DefEq env d (.forallE ty₁ body₁ m₁) (.forallE ty₂ body₂ m₂)
   379    /-- λ-congruence (`Core.lean:1644-1651`), as for ∀. -/
   380    | lam {d : Nat} {ty₁ body₁ ty₂ body₂ : Expr} {m₁ m₂ : BinderMeta} :
   381        DefEq env d ty₁ ty₂ →
   382        DefEq env (d + 1) (body₁.instantiate1 (.fvar d ty₂))
   383          (body₂.instantiate1 (.fvar d ty₂)) →
   384        m₁.pw = m₂.pw →
   385        DefEq env d (.lam ty₁ body₁ m₁) (.lam ty₂ body₂ m₂)
   386    /-- Per-node application congruence.  The checker's spine-wise
   387    congruence (`Core.lean:1652-1678`) and the same-head short-circuit

== whitepaper/Fragment/Rules.lean#L210-L230
   210    /-- **η** (`DefEq.eta`, `Rel.lean:400`): a λ against a term `b`
   211    whose inferred type reduces to a `∀` with a definitionally equal
   212    domain and the same annotation, when the λ's body is `b` applied to
   213    the variable.  Sound because a member of a function space is the
   214    abstraction of its applications (`SetLib.graph_app_eq`) — and at a
   215    proposition both sides are the one proof. -/
   216    | eta {Γ : List Expr} {A₁ b₁ b tb A₂ B : Expr} {pw : PropWhen} :
   217        Infer env Γ b tb → Red env Γ tb (pi A₂ pw B) →
   218        DefEq env Γ A₂ A₁ →
   219        DefEq env (A₁ :: Γ) b₁ (app (b.liftN 1) (bvar 0)) →
   220        DefEq env Γ (lam A₁ pw b₁) b
   221    /-- **Proof irrelevance** (`DefEq.proofIrrel`, `Rel.lean:417`): both
   222    sides' inferred types have sort `Prop`.  **The two types are never
   223    compared**: the model licenses that, because every proof denotes the
   224    one point. -/
   225    | proofIrrel {Γ : List Expr} {a ta tta b tb ttb : Expr} {u v : Level} :
   226        Infer env Γ a ta → Infer env Γ ta tta → Red env Γ tta (sort u) →
   227        LevelOracle.eq u .zero = true →
   228        Infer env Γ b tb → Infer env Γ tb ttb → Red env Γ ttb (sort v) →
   229        LevelOracle.eq v .zero = true →
   230        DefEq env Γ a b

== ConLeche/Rules/Rel.lean#L400-L422
   400    | eta {d : Nat} {ty₁ body₁ b tb ty₂ B : Expr} {m₁ m₂ : BinderMeta} :
   401        Infer env .io d b tb → Red env d tb (.forallE ty₂ B m₂) →
   402        DefEq env d ty₂ ty₁ →
   403        DefEq env (d + 1) (body₁.instantiate1 (.fvar d ty₁))
   404          (.app b (.fvar d ty₁)) →
   405        m₁.pw = m₂.pw →
   406        DefEq env d (.lam ty₁ body₁ m₁) b
   407    /-- **The `isProofFast` yes-arm** (`propIrrel`, `Core.lean:331-332`):
   408    both heads' validated data say "a proposition at every valuation" —
   409    the squash-regime licence (`prf_of_isProofFast`). -/
   410    | proofFast {d : Nat} {a b : Expr} :
   411        isProofFast env.find? a = true → isProofFast env.find? b = true →
   412        DefEq env d a b
   413    /-- **Proof irrelevance** (`propIrrel`'s slow arm, `Core.lean:338-356`,
   414    and `proofIrrel`'s `Prop` arm, `:295-325`): both sides' io-inferred
   415    types have sort `Prop`.  The two types are never compared — the
   416    model licenses that (every proof is the point). -/
   417    | proofIrrel {d : Nat} {a ta tta b tb ttb : Expr} {u v : Level} :
   418        Infer env .io d a ta → Infer env .io d ta tta →
   419        Red env d tta (.sort u) → Level.isEquiv u .zero = some true →
   420        Infer env .io d b tb → Infer env .io d tb ttb →
   421        Red env d ttb (.sort v) → Level.isEquiv v .zero = some true →
   422        DefEq env d a b

== whitepaper/Fragment/Rules.lean#L158-L175
   158  /-- **Definitional equality**: the verdict `true` of the checker's
   159  `isDefEq`.
   160  
   161  **There is no `trans` rule, deliberately** (`Rel.lean:310-333`, task
   162  #309).  The relation is the checker's verdict on two terms that are
   163  well-formed *together*, a fact no rule states because well-formedness
   164  is semantic (`WellDenoted`) and may not enter this inductive.  Every
   165  rule respects one discipline instead: **the subject of each `DefEq`
   166  premise is a subterm of the conclusion or is produced by a `Red` or
   167  `Infer` premise** (a reduct, an inferred type), so the soundness proof
   168  always has the premise's terms — and their invariant — in hand.  A
   169  `trans` rule is the unique rule that would break it: its middle term
   170  comes from nowhere, so nothing supplies its invariant, and the
   171  induction has nothing to apply the hypothesis to.  In the real checker
   172  the rule is not merely unprovable but unsound (`fvar`s carry
   173  annotations `DefEq.fvar` does not compare while `DefEq.proofFast`
   174  reads; `trans` lets the two meet).  The one sound chaining is "reduce,
   175  then continue": `redL`. -/

== ConLeche/Rules/Rel.lean#L310-L333
   310  /-- **Definitional equality**: the verdict `true` of `isDefEq`.
   311  
   312  **There is no `trans` rule, deliberately, and none can be added**
   313  (task #309, the experiment recorded in DESIGN.md).  The relation is
   314  not an equivalence on terms: it is the checker's verdict, and the
   315  checker only ever compares terms that are well-formed *together* — a
   316  fact the rules never state, because well-formedness (scoping, the
   317  readability of annotations, the grading of the reading) is semantic
   318  and may not enter this inductive.  Every rule respects one syntactic
   319  discipline instead: **the subject of each `DefEq` premise is either a
   320  subterm of the conclusion or is produced by an existence-form `Red` /
   321  `Infer` premise** (a reduct, an inferred type), so the soundness proof
   322  (`ConLeche/Model/Rules/Sound.lean`) always has the premise's terms in
   323  hand.  `trans` is the unique rule that would break it: its middle
   324  term comes from nowhere, and with it two rules that are each sound
   325  alone meet — `fvar` compares free variables by index only (their
   326  annotations are not compared, as the checker does not), while
   327  `proofFast` *reads* an annotation to decide "definitely a proof" —
   328  and derive `DefEq env d (.fvar i ty) (.fvar i' ty')` for every
   329  `i`, `i'`, which no model satisfies.  The recursive-structure rules
   330  (`redL`, `natSucc`, `eta`, `structUnit`) are therefore not a
   331  proof-engineering convenience but what keeps the relation sound; the
   332  one chaining that is sound, "reduce, then continue", is `redL`, and
   333  its right-hand and δ variants are derived in `Derived.lean`. -/

== whitepaper/Fragment/Rules.lean#L233-L246
   233  inductive Infer (env : Env) : List Expr → Expr → Expr → Prop where
   234    /-- A bound variable's type is its context entry, lifted over the
   235    binders in between (`Infer.fvar`, `Rel.lean:492`; the real checker
   236    reads the type off the free variable). -/
   237    | bvar {Γ : List Expr} {i : Nat} {A : Expr} :
   238        Γ[i]? = some A → Infer env Γ (bvar i) (A.liftN (i + 1))
   239    /-- `Sort u : Sort (u + 1)` (`Infer.sort`, `Rel.lean:488`). -/
   240    | sort {Γ : List Expr} {u : Level} :
   241        Infer env Γ (sort u) (sort (.succ u))
   242    /-- A stored constant at the right number of levels has its
   243    declared type, instantiated (`Infer.const`, `Rel.lean:496`). -/
   244    | const {Γ : List Expr} {c : Name} {ls : List Level} {ci : ConstInfo} :
   245        env.find? c = some ci → ls.length = ci.lparams.length →
   246        Infer env Γ (const c ls) (ci.type.instL ci.lparams ls)

== ConLeche/Rules/Rel.lean#L486-L502
   486  inductive Infer (env : Env) : Grade → Nat → Expr → Expr → Prop where
   487    /-- `Core.lean:1114` / `:1294`. -/
   488    | sort {g : Grade} {d : Nat} {u : Level} :
   489        Infer env g d (.sort u) (.sort (.succ u))
   490    /-- `Core.lean:1115-1123` / `:1295-1297`: an opened variable's stored
   491    type, at the leaf scope check. -/
   492    | fvar {g : Grade} {d idx : Nat} {ty : Expr} :
   493        idx < d → Infer env g d (.fvar idx ty) ty
   494    /-- `Core.lean:1125-1136` / `:1298-1309`: a stored constant that is
   495    not a projection table, at the right level arity. -/
   496    | const {g : Grade} {d : Nat} {n : Name} {us : List Level}
   497        {ci : ConstantInfo} :
   498        env.find? n = some ci → ci.isTowerEntry = false →
   499        us.length = ci.toConstantVal.levelParams.length →
   500        Infer env g d (.const n us)
   501          (ci.toConstantVal.type.instantiateLevelParams
   502            ci.toConstantVal.levelParams us)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Rules.lean#L247-L266
   247    /-- **`∀`-formation** (`Infer.forallE`, `Rel.lean:515`): the domain's
   248    type reduces to a sort `u`, the body's type (under the domain)
   249    reduces to a sort `v`, the result is `Sort (imax u v)` — and **the
   250    annotation is checked**: it must be the zero-ness datum of `v`. -/
   251    | pi {Γ : List Expr} {A B s t : Expr} {u v : Level} {pw : PropWhen} :
   252        Infer env Γ A s → Red env Γ s (sort u) →
   253        Infer env (A :: Γ) B t → Red env (A :: Γ) t (sort v) →
   254        Level.zeroness v = pw →
   255        Infer env Γ (pi A pw B) (sort (.imax u v))
   256    /-- **λ** (`Infer.lam`, `Rel.lean:530`): the domain's type reduces to
   257    a sort, the body is inferred under the domain, the body's type has a
   258    sort `v`, and **the annotation is checked** against `v`.  (The real
   259    checker validates the datum once per λ-chain; the fragment does it
   260    at every λ.) -/
   261    | lam {Γ : List Expr} {A b s bt btt : Expr} {u v : Level} {pw : PropWhen} :
   262        Infer env Γ A s → Red env Γ s (sort u) →
   263        Infer env (A :: Γ) b bt →
   264        Infer env (A :: Γ) bt btt → Red env (A :: Γ) btt (sort v) →
   265        Level.zeroness v = pw →
   266        Infer env Γ (lam A pw b) (pi A pw bt)

== ConLeche/Rules/Rel.lean#L515-L539
   515    | forallE {g : Grade} {d : Nat} {ty body s bs : Expr} {u v : Level}
   516        {mb : BinderMeta} :
   517        Infer env g d ty s → Red env d s (.sort u) →
   518        Infer env g (d + 1) (body.instantiate1 (.fvar d ty)) bs →
   519        Red env (d + 1) bs (.sort v) →
   520        Level.zeronessOf v = mb.pw →
   521        Infer env g d (.forallE ty body mb) (.sort (.imax u v))
   522    /-- **λ** (`Core.lean:1164-1214` / `:1327-1348`).  At the full grade the
   523    domain's type reduces to a sort (`g = .full →`: official's
   524    `infer_lambda` skips it at `infer_only`, and so does the io body);
   525    the opened body is inferred at the grade; the codomain datum is
   526    validated once per λ-chain — at an inner λ by datum equality with
   527    the neighbour, at the innermost binder by the io-grade sort
   528    computation on the body type (`body.lamPw = none →`).  The `s u btt
   529    v` witnesses are junk where their premise is vacuous. -/
   530    | lam {g : Grade} {d : Nat} {ty body s bt btt : Expr} {u v : Level}
   531        {mb : BinderMeta} :
   532        (g = .full → Infer env .full d ty s) →
   533        (g = .full → Red env d s (.sort u)) →
   534        Infer env g (d + 1) (body.instantiate1 (.fvar d ty)) bt →
   535        (∀ pwI, body.lamPw = some pwI → mb.pw = pwI) →
   536        (body.lamPw = none → Infer env .io (d + 1) bt btt) →
   537        (body.lamPw = none → Red env (d + 1) btt (.sort v)) →
   538        (body.lamPw = none → Level.zeronessOf v = mb.pw) →
   539        Infer env g d (.lam ty body mb) (.forallE ty (bt.abstract1 d) mb)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Rules.lean#L267-L276
   267    /-- **Application** (`Infer.app`, `Rel.lean:544`): the head's type
   268    reduces to a `∀`, and the argument's inferred type is definitionally
   269    equal to its domain.  This is where a syntactic proof would need
   270    Π-injectivity and the semantic one does not: the `∀` the head's type
   271    reduces to *is* a function space, and membership in it is what the
   272    model needs (`Sound.lean`, `infer_sound`'s `app` case). -/
   273    | app {Γ : List Expr} {f a tf A B ta : Expr} {pw : PropWhen} :
   274        Infer env Γ f tf → Red env Γ tf (pi A pw B) →
   275        Infer env Γ a ta → DefEq env Γ ta A →
   276        Infer env Γ (app f a) (B.inst a)

== ConLeche/Rules/Rel.lean#L544-L547
   544    | app {g : Grade} {d : Nat} {f a tf ty body ta : Expr} {mt : BinderMeta} :
   545        Infer env g d f tf → Red env d tf (.forallE ty body mt) →
   546        Infer env g d a ta → DefEq env d ta ty →
   547        Infer env g d (.app f a) (body.instantiate1 a)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Lib.lean#L36-L87
    36  class SetLib (V : Type u) where
    37    /-- Membership. -/
    38    Mem : V → V → Prop
    39    /-- Extensionality. -/
    40    ext : ∀ {x y : V}, (∀ z, Mem z x ↔ Mem z y) → x = y
    41    /-- The canonical point: the one proof of every true proposition. -/
    42    pt : V
    43    /-- The truth value of a proposition: `{pt}` if it holds, `∅` if
    44    not. -/
    45    truthVal : Prop → V
    46    /-- The members of a truth value. -/
    47    mem_truthVal : ∀ {p : Prop} {z : V}, Mem z (truthVal p) ↔ z = pt ∧ p
    48    /-- The universe chain: `univ n` interprets `Sort n`. -/
    49    univ : Nat → V
    50    /-- `univ 0` is the set of truth values: the subsets of `{pt}`. -/
    51    mem_univ_zero : ∀ {T : V}, Mem T (univ 0) ↔ ∀ z, Mem z T → z = pt
    52    /-- Each universe is a member of the next. -/
    53    univ_mem_succ : ∀ n : Nat, Mem (univ n) (univ (n + 1))
    54    /-- Cumulativity. -/
    55    univ_mono : ∀ {m n : Nat} {x : V}, m ≤ n → Mem x (univ m) → Mem x (univ n)
    56    /-- The graph of a function on a domain. -/
    57    graph : (V → V) → V → V
    58    /-- The dependent function space: the graphs over `A` with values
    59    in the fibres `B`. -/
    60    piSet : V → (V → V) → V
    61    /-- Application.  On the point it is the point (a proof applied to
    62    anything is a proof); on a graph it reads the graph. -/
    63    app : V → V → V
    64    /-- A proof applied is the proof. -/
    65    app_pt : ∀ a : V, app pt a = pt
    66    /-- β: a graph applied on its domain computes. -/
    67    app_graph : ∀ {F : V → V} {A a : V}, Mem a A → app (graph F A) a = F a
    68    /-- A graph is never the point. -/
    69    graph_ne_pt : ∀ {F : V → V} {A : V}, graph F A ≠ pt
    70    /-- A graph depends only on the function's values on the domain. -/
    71    graph_congr : ∀ {F F' : V → V} {A : V}, (∀ x, Mem x A → F x = F' x) → graph F A = graph F' A
    72    /-- A function space depends only on the fibres over the domain. -/
    73    piSet_congr : ∀ {A : V} {B B' : V → V}, (∀ x, Mem x A → B x = B' x) → piSet A B = piSet A B'
    74    /-- Introduction: fibre-wise members abstract into the space. -/
    75    graph_mem_piSet : ∀ {A : V} {F B : V → V},
    76      (∀ x, Mem x A → Mem (F x) (B x)) → Mem (graph F A) (piSet A B)
    77    /-- Elimination. -/
    78    app_mem_piSet : ∀ {A f a : V} {B : V → V}, Mem f (piSet A B) → Mem a A → Mem (app f a) (B a)
    79    /-- η: a member of a function space is the graph of its applications. -/
    80    graph_app_eq : ∀ {A f : V} {B : V → V}, Mem f (piSet A B) → graph (fun x => app f x) A = f
    81    /-- A graph determines its domain. -/
    82    piSet_dom_unique : ∀ {A A' f : V} {B B' : V → V},
    83      Mem f (piSet A B) → Mem f (piSet A' B') → A = A'
    84    /-- Closure of the positive universes under dependent function
    85    spaces. -/
    86    piSet_mem_univ : ∀ {n : Nat} {A : V} {B : V → V}, n ≠ 0 →
    87      Mem A (univ n) → (∀ x, Mem x A → Mem (B x) (univ n)) → Mem (piSet A B) (univ n)

== ConLeche/SetTheory/Core.lean#L95-L100
    95  /-- A model of set theory of exactly the strength the checker needs:
    96  membership, the six ZF⁻ axioms (extensionality, pairing, union, power
    97  set, regularity, Lean-level replacement), and an ω-chain of
    98  Grothendieck universes.  Infinity is derivable; choice is inherited
    99  from the meta-logic (`Classical.choice`); see the module docstring. -/
   100  class SetTheory (V : Type u) where

== whitepaper/Fragment/Interp.lean#L124-L130
   124  def interp (M : Name → List Nat → V) (φ : Name → Nat) : (Nat → V) → Expr → V
   125    | ρ, .bvar i => ρ i
   126    | _, .sort u => univ (u.eval φ)
   127    | _, .const c ls => M c (ls.map (Level.eval φ))
   128    | ρ, .app f a => app (interp M φ ρ f) (interp M φ ρ a)
   129    | ρ, .lam A pw b => lamR (pw.holds φ) (interp M φ ρ A) fun x => interp M φ (cons x ρ) b
   130    | ρ, .pi A pw B => piR (pw.holds φ) (interp M φ ρ A) fun x => interp M φ (cons x ρ) B

== whitepaper/Fragment/PropWhen.lean#L191-L194
   191  def holds (pw : PropWhen) (φ : Name → Nat) : Bool :=
   192    match pw with
   193    | never => false
   194    | whenZero ps => ps.list.all fun n => φ n == 0

== whitepaper/Fragment/Lib.lean#L125-L130
   125  def piR (p : Bool) (A : V) (B : V → V) : V :=
   126    if p then truthVal (∀ x, x ∈ˢ A → ∃ y, y ∈ˢ B x) else piSet A B
   127  
   128  /-- Abstraction at regime `p`: the point when `p`, the graph above it. -/
   129  def lamR (p : Bool) (A : V) (F : V → V) : V :=
   130    if p then pt else graph F A

== ConLeche/SetModel/Ops.lean#L60-L66
    60  noncomputable def piR (v : Nat) (A : V) (B : V → V) : V :=
    61    if v = 0 then truthVal (∀ x, x ∈ˢ A → ∃ y, y ∈ˢ B x) else piSet A B
    62  
    63  /-- Abstraction at codomain sort `v`: the canonical proof at `0`, the
    64  literal function graph above it. -/
    65  noncomputable def lamR (v : Nat) (A : V) (F : V → V) : V :=
    66    if v = 0 then pt else graph F A

== ConLeche/Semantics/Interp.lean#L150-L156
   150  noncomputable def interp : (Nat → V) → AnnotTerm → V
   151    | ρ, .bvar i => ρ i
   152    | _, .sort u => univ u
   153    | _, .const c us => bval V c us
   154    | ρ, .app f a => SetTheory.app (interp ρ f) (interp ρ a)
   155    | ρ, .lam v A b => lamR v (interp ρ A) fun x => interp (cons x ρ) b
   156    | ρ, .pi _ v A B => piR v (interp ρ A) fun x => interp (cons x ρ) B

== whitepaper/Fragment/WellDenoted.lean#L50-L68
    50  def WellDenoted (M : Name → List Nat → V) (φ : Name → Nat) : (Nat → V) → Expr → Prop
    51    | ρ, .pi A pw B =>
    52      WellDenoted M φ ρ A ∧
    53      (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp M φ ρ A → WellDenoted M φ (cons x ρ) B) ∧
    54      (pw.holds φ = true → ∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp M φ ρ A → interp M φ (cons x ρ) B ∈ˢ univ 0)
    55    | ρ, .lam A pw b =>
    56      WellDenoted M φ ρ A ∧
    57      (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp M φ ρ A → WellDenoted M φ (cons x ρ) b) ∧
    58      ∃ B : V → V,
    59        (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp M φ ρ A → interp M φ (cons x ρ) b ∈ˢ B x) ∧
    60        (pw.holds φ = true → ∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp M φ ρ A → B x ∈ˢ univ 0)
    61    | ρ, .app f a =>
    62      WellDenoted M φ ρ f ∧ WellDenoted M φ ρ a ∧
    63      ∃ (p : Bool) (A : V) (B : V → V),
    64        interp M φ ρ f ∈ˢ piR p A B ∧ interp M φ ρ a ∈ˢ A ∧
    65        (p = true → ∀ x, x ∈ˢ A → B x ∈ˢ univ 0)
    66    | _, .bvar _ => True
    67    | _, .sort _ => True
    68    | _, .const _ _ => True

== ConLeche/Semantics/WellDenoted.lean#L81-L95
    81  def WellDenoted : (Nat → V) → AnnotTerm → Prop
    82    | ρ, .pi _u _v A B =>
    83      WellDenoted ρ A ∧
    84      ∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → WellDenoted (cons x ρ) B
    85    | ρ, .lam v A b =>
    86      WellDenoted ρ A ∧
    87      (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → WellDenoted (cons x ρ) b) ∧
    88      ∃ B : V → V,
    89        (∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → interp V (cons x ρ) b ∈ˢ B x) ∧
    90        (v = 0 → ∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp V ρ A → B x ∈ˢ (univZero : V))
    91    | ρ, .app f a =>
    92      WellDenoted ρ f ∧ WellDenoted ρ a ∧
    93      ∃ (v : Nat) (A : V) (B : V → V),
    94        interp V ρ f ∈ˢ piR v A B ∧ interp V ρ a ∈ˢ A ∧
    95        (v = 0 → ∀ x, x ∈ˢ A → B x ∈ˢ (univZero : V))

   183  theorem WellDenoted_inst0 {e a : Expr} {ρ : Nat → V} (ha : WellDenoted M φ ρ a) :
   184      WellDenoted M φ ρ (e.inst a) ↔
   185        WellDenoted M φ (cons (interp M φ ρ a) ρ) e := by
   186    have h := WellDenoted_inst M φ e a 0 ρ (by rwa [shiftE_zero_zero])
   187    rwa [shiftE_zero_zero, instE_zero] at h

== whitepaper/Fragment/WellDenoted.lean#L287-L292
   287  def Sat (M : Name → List Nat → V) (φ : Name → Nat) : List Expr → (Nat → V) → Prop
   288    | [], _ => True
   289    | A :: Γ, ρ =>
   290      Sat M φ Γ (fun i => ρ (i + 1)) ∧
   291      WellDenoted M φ (fun i => ρ (i + 1)) A ∧
   292      ρ 0 ∈ˢ interp M φ (fun i => ρ (i + 1)) A

== whitepaper/Fragment/WellDenoted.lean#L227-L247
   227  theorem WellDenoted_beta_graph {A b a : Expr} {ρ : Nat → V}
   228      (h : WellDenoted M φ ρ (.app (.lam A .never b) a)) :
   229      interp M φ ρ (.app (.lam A .never b) a) = interp M φ ρ (b.inst a) ∧
   230      WellDenoted M φ ρ (b.inst a) := by
   231    rw [WellDenoted_app] at h
   232    obtain ⟨hlam, ha, p, A', B', hslot, hmem, -⟩ := h
   233    rw [WellDenoted_lam] at hlam
   234    obtain ⟨-, hbody, B, hfib, -⟩ := hlam
   235    -- the slot's product is in the graph regime: the λ is not the point
   236    have hp : p = false := by
   237      cases p
   238      · rfl
   239      · exact absurd (eq_pt_of_mem_piR_true hslot) lamR_false_ne_pt
   240    subst hp
   241    -- a graph determines its domain: the slot's domain is the λ's own
   242    have hown : interp M φ ρ (.lam A .never b) ∈ˢ piR false (interp M φ ρ A) B :=
   243      lamR_mem hfib
   244    have hAA : interp M φ ρ A = A' := piR_dom_unique hown hslot
   245    have haA : interp M φ ρ a ∈ˢ interp M φ ρ A := by rw [hAA]; exact hmem
   246    refine ⟨?_, (WellDenoted_inst0 M φ ha).mpr (hbody _ haA)⟩
   247    rw [interp_app, interp_lam, PropWhen.holds_never, app_lamR_false haA, interp_inst0]

   254      (h : WellDenoted M φ ρ (.app (.lam A pw b) a))
   255      (hmem : interp M φ ρ a ∈ˢ interp M φ ρ A) :
   256      interp M φ ρ (.app (.lam A pw b) a) = interp M φ ρ (b.inst a) ∧

   262    refine ⟨?_, (WellDenoted_inst0 M φ ha).mpr (hbody _ hmem)⟩

== whitepaper/Fragment/WellDenoted.lean#L271-L280
   271  theorem WellDenoted_app_of {ρ : Nat → V} {f a A B : Expr} {pw : PropWhen}
   272      (hf : WellDenoted M φ ρ f) (ha : WellDenoted M φ ρ a)
   273      (hpi : WellDenoted M φ ρ (.pi A pw B))
   274      (hmemf : interp M φ ρ f ∈ˢ interp M φ ρ (.pi A pw B))
   275      (hmema : interp M φ ρ a ∈ˢ interp M φ ρ A) :
   276      WellDenoted M φ ρ (.app f a) := by
   277    rw [WellDenoted_pi] at hpi
   278    rw [WellDenoted_app]
   279    exact ⟨hf, ha, pw.holds φ, interp M φ ρ A, fun x => interp M φ (cons x ρ) B,
   280      hmemf, hmema, hpi.2.2⟩

== whitepaper/Fragment/EnvModel.lean#L164-L189
   164  structure EnvModel (V : Type u) [SetLib V] (env : Env) where
   165    /-- The set of every constant at every list of concrete levels. -/
   166    M : Name → List Nat → V
   167    /-- Every stored constant's type, instantiated, is well-denoted, and
   168    the constant is a member of it — at every valuation and every
   169    environment (the types are closed, so `ρ` is irrelevant, and stating
   170    it for all `ρ` saves a closedness lemma). -/
   171    type_ok : ∀ (c : Name) (ci : ConstInfo), env.find? c = some ci →
   172      ∀ (φ : Name → Nat) (ρ : Nat → V) (ls : List Level), ls.length = ci.lparams.length →
   173        WellDenoted M φ ρ (ci.type.instL ci.lparams ls) ∧
   174        M c (ls.map (Level.eval φ)) ∈ˢ interp M φ ρ (ci.type.instL ci.lparams ls)
   175    /-- A definition's value, instantiated, is well-denoted and denotes
   176    the constant. -/
   177    unfold : ∀ (c : Name) (ci : ConstInfo) (v : Expr), env.find? c = some ci →
   178      ci.value? = some v →
   179      ∀ (φ : Name → Nat) (ρ : Nat → V) (ls : List Level), ls.length = ci.lparams.length →
   180        WellDenoted M φ ρ (v.instL ci.lparams ls) ∧
   181        interp M φ ρ (v.instL ci.lparams ls) = M c (ls.map (Level.eval φ))
   182    /-- Every rule of every stored recursor satisfies its ι law. -/
   183    rec_rules : ∀ (c : Name) (ci : ConstInfo) (numParams numMotives numMinors numIndices : Nat)
   184      (rules : List RecRule),
   185      env.find? c = some ci →
   186      ci.kind = .recursor numParams numMotives numMinors numIndices rules →
   187      ∀ rl ∈ rules, ∀ cij : ConstInfo, env.find? rl.ctor = some cij →
   188        RecRuleLaw M c ci numParams (numParams + numMotives + numMinors)
   189          (numParams + numMotives + numMinors + numIndices) rl cij

   171    type_ok : ∀ (c : Name) (ci : ConstInfo), env.find? c = some ci →

   173        WellDenoted M φ ρ (ci.type.instL ci.lparams ls) ∧
   174        M c (ls.map (Level.eval φ)) ∈ˢ interp M φ ρ (ci.type.instL ci.lparams ls)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L677-L681
   677  theorem soundness [LevelOracle] (m : EnvModel V env) (φ : Name → Nat) :
   678      (∀ {Γ : List Expr} {e e' : Expr}, Red env Γ e e' → RedSem m φ Γ e e') ∧
   679      (∀ {Γ : List Expr} {a b : Expr}, DefEq env Γ a b → DefEqSem m φ Γ a b) ∧
   680      (∀ {Γ : List Expr} {e T : Expr}, Infer env Γ e T → InferSem m φ Γ e T) :=
   681    ⟨red_sound, defeq_sound, infer_sound⟩

== whitepaper/Fragment/Motive.lean#L40-L53
    40  def RedSem (m : EnvModel V env) (φ : Name → Nat) (Γ : List Expr) (e e' : Expr) : Prop :=
    41    ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat m.M φ Γ ρ → WellDenoted m.M φ ρ e →
    42      WellDenoted m.M φ ρ e' ∧ interp m.M φ ρ e = interp m.M φ ρ e'
    43  
    44  /-- **`DefEq`'s claim**: equal denotations. -/
    45  def DefEqSem (m : EnvModel V env) (φ : Name → Nat) (Γ : List Expr) (a b : Expr) : Prop :=
    46    ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat m.M φ Γ ρ → WellDenoted m.M φ ρ a → WellDenoted m.M φ ρ b →
    47      interp m.M φ ρ a = interp m.M φ ρ b
    48  
    49  /-- **`Infer`'s claim**: the term and its type are well-denoted, and
    50  the term's denotation is a member of the type's. -/
    51  def InferSem (m : EnvModel V env) (φ : Name → Nat) (Γ : List Expr) (e T : Expr) : Prop :=
    52    ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat m.M φ Γ ρ →
    53      WellDenoted m.M φ ρ e ∧ WellDenoted m.M φ ρ T ∧ interp m.M φ ρ e ∈ˢ interp m.M φ ρ T

== ConLeche/Model/Rules/Motive.lean#L71-L105
    71  @[expose] def RedSem {env : Env} (m : EnvModel V env) (φ : Name → Nat)
    72      (d : Nat) (e e' : Expr) : Prop :=
    73    Frame d e →
    74    ∀ {Δa : List AnnotTerm} {ea : AnnotTerm},
    75      CtxOk m φ d Δa e →
    76      denoteMeta m.acval env φ d e = some ea →
    77      Graded V Δa ea →
    78      Frame d e' ∧ LeavesSub e' e ∧
    79        ∃ ea', denoteMeta m.acval env φ d e' = some ea' ∧
    80          Graded V Δa ea' ∧
    81          ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → interp V ρ ea = interp V ρ ea'
    82  
    83  /-- **`DefEq`'s motive**: `DefEqClaim`'s conclusion under its premises. -/
    84  @[expose] def DefEqSem {env : Env} (m : EnvModel V env) (φ : Name → Nat)
    85      (d : Nat) (a b : Expr) : Prop :=
    86    Frame d a → Frame d b →
    87    ∀ {Δa : List AnnotTerm} {aa ba : AnnotTerm},
    88      CtxOk m φ d Δa a → CtxOk m φ d Δa b →
    89      denoteMeta m.acval env φ d a = some aa →
    90      denoteMeta m.acval env φ d b = some ba →
    91      Graded V Δa aa → Graded V Δa ba →
    92      ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → interp V ρ aa = interp V ρ ba
    93  
    94  /-- **`Infer`'s motive at the full grade** — establishment: the
    95  subject's grading is a conclusion. -/
    96  @[expose] def InferSemFull {env : Env} (m : EnvModel V env) (φ : Name → Nat)
    97      (d : Nat) (e t : Expr) : Prop :=
    98    Frame d e →
    99    ∀ {Δa : List AnnotTerm} {ea : AnnotTerm},
   100      CtxOk m φ d Δa e →
   101      denoteMeta m.acval env φ d e = some ea →
   102      Frame d t ∧ LeavesSub t e ∧
   103        ∃ ta, denoteMeta m.acval env φ d t = some ta ∧
   104          Graded V Δa ea ∧ Graded V Δa ta ∧
   105          ∀ ρ : Nat → V, Sat V Δa ρ → interp V ρ ea ∈ˢ interp V ρ ta

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L685-L688
   685  theorem closed_infer [LevelOracle] (m : EnvModel V env) (φ : Name → Nat) {e T : Expr}
   686      (h : Infer env [] e T) (ρ : Nat → V) :
   687      interp m.M φ ρ e ∈ˢ interp m.M φ ρ T :=
   688    (infer_sound h ρ (Sat_nil m.M φ ρ)).2.2

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L620-L667
   620  mutual
   621  
   622  /-- Every reduction is sound. -/
   623  theorem red_sound [LevelOracle] : ∀ {Γ : List Expr} {e e' : Expr}, Red env Γ e e' → RedSem m φ Γ e e'
   624    | _, _, _, .refl => Red.refl_sound
   625    | _, _, _, .trans h₁ h₂ => Red.trans_sound (red_sound h₁) (red_sound h₂)
   626    | _, _, _, .appFn h => Red.appFn_sound (red_sound h)
   627    | _, _, _, .betaGate => Red.betaGate_sound
   628    | _, _, _, .beta hta hd => Red.beta_sound (infer_sound hta) (defeq_sound hd)
   629    | _, _, _, .delta hfind hv hls => Red.delta_sound hfind hv hls
   630    | _, _, _, .iota hfind hkind hus hlen hpis hmaj hmeq hrl hctor hcij husj hmlen hpis' hdoms htys
   631        hI hD hdoms' htys' hI' hD' hlv hP hres hshape hrps hX =>
   632      Red.iota_sound rfl rfl hfind hkind hus hlen hpis (red_sound hmaj) hmeq hrl hctor hcij husj
   633        hmlen hpis' hdoms htys (fun p hp => infer_sound (hI p hp)) (fun p hp => defeq_sound (hD p hp))
   634        hdoms' htys' (fun p hp => infer_sound (hI' p hp)) (fun p hp => defeq_sound (hD' p hp))
   635        hlv (fun p hp => defeq_sound (hP p hp)) hres hshape hrps
   636        (fun p hp => defeq_sound (hX p hp))
   637  
   638  /-- Every definitional-equality verdict is sound. -/
   639  theorem defeq_sound [LevelOracle] : ∀ {Γ : List Expr} {a b : Expr}, DefEq env Γ a b → DefEqSem m φ Γ a b
   640    | _, _, _, .refl => DefEq.refl_sound
   641    | _, _, _, .symm h => DefEq.symm_sound (defeq_sound h)
   642    | _, _, _, .redL hr h => DefEq.redL_sound (red_sound hr) (defeq_sound h)
   643    | _, _, _, .sort h => DefEq.sort_sound h
   644    | _, _, _, .const h => DefEq.const_sound h
   645    | _, _, _, .pi hA hB => DefEq.pi_sound (defeq_sound hA) (defeq_sound hB)
   646    | _, _, _, .lam hA hb => DefEq.lam_sound (defeq_sound hA) (defeq_sound hb)
   647    | _, _, _, .app hf ha => DefEq.app_sound (defeq_sound hf) (defeq_sound ha)
   648    | _, _, _, .eta htb hr hA hbody =>
   649      DefEq.eta_sound (infer_sound htb) (red_sound hr) (defeq_sound hA) (defeq_sound hbody)
   650    | _, _, _, .proofIrrel hta htta hu hu0 htb httb hv hv0 =>
   651      DefEq.proofIrrel_sound (infer_sound hta) (infer_sound htta) (red_sound hu) hu0
   652        (infer_sound htb) (infer_sound httb) (red_sound hv) hv0
   653  
   654  /-- Every inference is sound. -/
   655  theorem infer_sound [LevelOracle] : ∀ {Γ : List Expr} {e T : Expr}, Infer env Γ e T → InferSem m φ Γ e T
   656    | _, _, _, .bvar h => Infer.bvar_sound h
   657    | _, _, _, .sort => Infer.sort_sound
   658    | _, _, _, .const hfind hls => Infer.const_sound hfind hls
   659    | _, _, _, .pi hA hu hB hv hz =>
   660      Infer.pi_sound (infer_sound hA) (red_sound hu) (infer_sound hB) (red_sound hv) hz
   661    | _, _, _, .lam hA hu hb hbt hv hz =>
   662      Infer.lam_sound (infer_sound hA) (red_sound hu) (infer_sound hb) (infer_sound hbt)
   663        (red_sound hv) hz
   664    | _, _, _, .app hf hr ha hd =>
   665      Infer.app_sound (infer_sound hf) (red_sound hr) (infer_sound ha) (defeq_sound hd)
   666  
   667  end

   180  theorem beta_sound {Γ : List Expr} {A b a ta : Expr} {pw : PropWhen}
   181      (hta : InferSem m φ Γ a ta) (hd : DefEqSem m φ Γ ta A) :
   182      RedSem m φ Γ (Expr.app (Expr.lam A pw b) a) (b.inst a) := by

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L424-L458
   424  theorem eta_sound {Γ : List Expr} {A₁ b₁ b tb A₂ B : Expr} {pw : PropWhen}
   425      (htb : InferSem m φ Γ b tb) (hr : RedSem m φ Γ tb (Expr.pi A₂ pw B))
   426      (hA : DefEqSem m φ Γ A₂ A₁)
   427      (hbody : DefEqSem m φ (A₁ :: Γ) b₁ (Expr.app (b.liftN 1) (Expr.bvar 0))) :
   428      DefEqSem m φ Γ (Expr.lam A₁ pw b₁) b := by
   429    intro ρ hs hlam hwb
   430    -- `⟦b⟧` is a member of the product its type reduces to
   431    obtain ⟨-, hwtb, hmemb⟩ := htb ρ hs
   432    obtain ⟨hwpi, hepi⟩ := hr ρ hs hwtb
   433    rw [hepi, interp_pi] at hmemb
   434    rw [WellDenoted_pi] at hwpi
   435    rw [WellDenoted_lam] at hlam
   436    have heA : interp m.M φ ρ A₂ = interp m.M φ ρ A₁ := hA ρ hs hwpi.1 hlam.1
   437    -- the lifted `b` under the binder is `b`
   438    have hsh : ∀ x, shiftE 1 0 (cons x ρ) = ρ := by
   439      intro x; funext i; simp [shiftE]
   440    have hlift : ∀ x, interp m.M φ (cons x ρ) (b.liftN 1) = interp m.M φ ρ b := by
   441      intro x
   442      rw [interp_liftN, hsh]
   443    -- the body, pointwise, is `b` applied
   444    have hpt : ∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp m.M φ ρ A₁ →
   445        interp m.M φ (cons x ρ) b₁ = SetLib.app (interp m.M φ ρ b) x := by
   446      intro x hx
   447      have hx₂ : x ∈ˢ interp m.M φ ρ A₂ := by rw [heA]; exact hx
   448      have happ : WellDenoted m.M φ (cons x ρ) (Expr.app (b.liftN 1) (Expr.bvar 0)) := by
   449        rw [WellDenoted_app]
   450        refine ⟨(WellDenoted_liftN m.M φ 1 b 0 (cons x ρ)).mpr ?_, trivial,
   451          pw.holds φ, interp m.M φ ρ A₂, fun y => interp m.M φ (cons y ρ) B, ?_, hx₂, hwpi.2.2⟩
   452        · rw [hsh]; exact hwb
   453        · rw [hlift]; exact hmemb
   454      have := hbody (cons x ρ) ((Sat_cons m.M φ).mpr ⟨hs, hlam.1, hx⟩) (hlam.2.1 x hx) happ
   455      rw [this, interp_app, interp_bvar, cons_zero, hlift]
   456    -- η in the model
   457    rw [interp_lam, lamR_congr hpt, ← heA]
   458    exact lamR_eta hmemb

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L461-L481
   461  theorem eq_pt_of_prop [LevelOracle] {Γ : List Expr} {a ta tta : Expr} {u : Level}
   462      (hta : InferSem m φ Γ a ta) (htta : InferSem m φ Γ ta tta)
   463      (hu : RedSem m φ Γ tta (Expr.sort u)) (hu0 : LevelOracle.eq u .zero = true)
   464      (ρ : Nat → V) (hs : Sat m.M φ Γ ρ) : interp m.M φ ρ a = pt := by
   465    obtain ⟨-, hwta, hmem⟩ := hta ρ hs
   466    obtain ⟨-, hwtta, hmem₂⟩ := htta ρ hs
   467    obtain ⟨-, heq⟩ := hu ρ hs hwtta
   468    rw [heq, interp_sort, eval_eq_of_oracle hu0, Level.eval_zero] at hmem₂
   469    exact eq_pt_of_mem_univ_zero hmem₂ hmem
   470  
   471  /-- **Proof irrelevance is sound, for free.**  Each side's type has
   472  sort `Prop`, so each side's denotation is a member of a truth value,
   473  hence the point; the two types are never compared, and need not be. -/
   474  theorem proofIrrel_sound [LevelOracle] {Γ : List Expr} {a ta tta b tb ttb : Expr} {u v : Level}
   475      (hta : InferSem m φ Γ a ta) (htta : InferSem m φ Γ ta tta)
   476      (hu : RedSem m φ Γ tta (Expr.sort u)) (hu0 : LevelOracle.eq u .zero = true)
   477      (htb : InferSem m φ Γ b tb) (httb : InferSem m φ Γ tb ttb)
   478      (hv : RedSem m φ Γ ttb (Expr.sort v)) (hv0 : LevelOracle.eq v .zero = true) :
   479      DefEqSem m φ Γ a b := by
   480    intro ρ hs _ _
   481    rw [eq_pt_of_prop hta htta hu hu0 ρ hs, eq_pt_of_prop htb httb hv hv0 ρ hs]

   313  theorem DefEq.proofIrrel_sound {d : Nat}
   314      {a ta tta b tb ttb : Expr} {u v : Level}
   315      (hta : InferSemIO m φ d a ta) (htta : InferSemIO m φ d ta tta)
   316      (hu : RedSem m φ d tta (.sort u)) (hu0 : Level.isEquiv u .zero = some true)
   317      (htb : InferSemIO m φ d b tb) (httb : InferSemIO m φ d tb ttb)
   318      (hv : RedSem m φ d ttb (.sort v)) (hv0 : Level.isEquiv v .zero = some true) :
   319      DefEqSem m φ d a b := by
   320    intro hfa hfb Δa aa ba hCa hCb haa hba hga hgb ρ hρ

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L514-L548
   514  theorem pi_sound {Γ : List Expr} {A B s t : Expr} {u v : Level} {pw : PropWhen}
   515      (hA : InferSem m φ Γ A s) (hu : RedSem m φ Γ s (Expr.sort u))
   516      (hB : InferSem m φ (A :: Γ) B t) (hv : RedSem m φ (A :: Γ) t (Expr.sort v))
   517      (hz : Level.zeroness v = pw) :
   518      InferSem m φ Γ (Expr.pi A pw B) (Expr.sort (.imax u v)) := by
   519    intro ρ hs
   520    obtain ⟨hwA, hws, hmemA⟩ := hA ρ hs
   521    obtain ⟨-, hes⟩ := hu ρ hs hws
   522    rw [hes, interp_sort] at hmemA
   523    have hbody : ∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp m.M φ ρ A →
   524        WellDenoted m.M φ (cons x ρ) B ∧ interp m.M φ (cons x ρ) B ∈ˢ univ (Level.eval φ v) := by
   525      intro x hx
   526      have hs' : Sat m.M φ (A :: Γ) (cons x ρ) := (Sat_cons m.M φ).mpr ⟨hs, hwA, hx⟩
   527      obtain ⟨hwB, hwt, hmemB⟩ := hB (cons x ρ) hs'
   528      obtain ⟨-, het⟩ := hv (cons x ρ) hs' hwt
   529      rw [het, interp_sort] at hmemB
   530      exact ⟨hwB, hmemB⟩
   531    have hzero := holds_of_zeroness (φ := φ) hz
   532    refine ⟨?_, trivial, ?_⟩
   533    · rw [WellDenoted_pi]
   534      refine ⟨hwA, fun x hx => (hbody x hx).1, fun hp x hx => ?_⟩
   535      have := (hbody x hx).2
   536      rwa [hzero.mp hp] at this
   537    · rw [interp_pi, interp_sort, Level.eval_imax]
   538      by_cases h0 : Level.eval φ v = 0
   539      · rw [hzero.mpr h0, (Level.imaxNat_eq_zero_iff _ _).mpr h0]
   540        exact piR_true_mem_univ_zero
   541      · have hp : pw.holds φ = false := by
   542          cases hh : pw.holds φ
   543          · rfl
   544          · exact absurd (hzero.mp hh) h0
   545        rw [hp, Level.imaxNat_of_ne_zero h0]
   546        refine piR_false_mem_univ (by omega) (univ_mono (Nat.le_max_left _ _) hmemA) ?_
   547        intro x hx
   548        exact univ_mono (Nat.le_max_right _ _) (hbody x hx).2

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L46-L48
    46  theorem holds_of_zeroness {v : Level} {pw : PropWhen} (h : Level.zeroness v = pw) :
    47      pw.holds φ = true ↔ Level.eval φ v = 0 := by
    48    subst h; exact Level.holds_zeroness φ v

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L556-L588
   556  theorem lam_sound {Γ : List Expr} {A b s bt btt : Expr} {u v : Level} {pw : PropWhen}
   557      (hA : InferSem m φ Γ A s) (_hu : RedSem m φ Γ s (Expr.sort u))
   558      (hb : InferSem m φ (A :: Γ) b bt)
   559      (hbt : InferSem m φ (A :: Γ) bt btt) (hv : RedSem m φ (A :: Γ) btt (Expr.sort v))
   560      (hz : Level.zeroness v = pw) :
   561      InferSem m φ Γ (Expr.lam A pw b) (Expr.pi A pw bt) := by
   562    intro ρ hs
   563    obtain ⟨hwA, -, -⟩ := hA ρ hs
   564    have hbody : ∀ x, x ∈ˢ interp m.M φ ρ A →
   565        WellDenoted m.M φ (cons x ρ) b ∧ WellDenoted m.M φ (cons x ρ) bt ∧
   566        interp m.M φ (cons x ρ) b ∈ˢ interp m.M φ (cons x ρ) bt ∧
   567        interp m.M φ (cons x ρ) bt ∈ˢ univ (Level.eval φ v) := by
   568      intro x hx
   569      have hs' : Sat m.M φ (A :: Γ) (cons x ρ) := (Sat_cons m.M φ).mpr ⟨hs, hwA, hx⟩
   570      obtain ⟨hwb, hwbt, hmemb⟩ := hb (cons x ρ) hs'
   571      obtain ⟨-, hwbtt, hmembt⟩ := hbt (cons x ρ) hs'
   572      obtain ⟨-, hebtt⟩ := hv (cons x ρ) hs' hwbtt
   573      rw [hebtt, interp_sort] at hmembt
   574      exact ⟨hwb, hwbt, hmemb, hmembt⟩
   575    have hzero := holds_of_zeroness (φ := φ) hz
   576    have hpi : WellDenoted m.M φ ρ (Expr.pi A pw bt) := by
   577      rw [WellDenoted_pi]
   578      refine ⟨hwA, fun x hx => (hbody x hx).2.1, fun hp x hx => ?_⟩
   579      have := (hbody x hx).2.2.2
   580      rwa [hzero.mp hp] at this
   581    refine ⟨?_, hpi, ?_⟩
   582    · rw [WellDenoted_lam]
   583      refine ⟨hwA, fun x hx => (hbody x hx).1, fun x => interp m.M φ (cons x ρ) bt,
   584        fun x hx => (hbody x hx).2.2.1, fun hp x hx => ?_⟩
   585      have := (hbody x hx).2.2.2
   586      rwa [hzero.mp hp] at this
   587    · rw [interp_lam, interp_pi]
   588      exact lamR_mem fun x hx => (hbody x hx).2.2.1

== whitepaper/Fragment/Sound.lean#L598-L614
   598  theorem app_sound {Γ : List Expr} {f a tf A B ta : Expr} {pw : PropWhen}
   599      (hf : InferSem m φ Γ f tf) (hr : RedSem m φ Γ tf (Expr.pi A pw B))
   600      (ha : InferSem m φ Γ a ta) (hd : DefEqSem m φ Γ ta A) :
   601      InferSem m φ Γ (Expr.app f a) (B.inst a) := by
   602    intro ρ hs
   603    obtain ⟨hwf, hwtf, hmemf⟩ := hf ρ hs
   604    obtain ⟨hwpi, hepi⟩ := hr ρ hs hwtf
   605    rw [hepi] at hmemf
   606    obtain ⟨hwa, hwta, hmema⟩ := ha ρ hs
   607    have hwpi' := hwpi
   608    rw [WellDenoted_pi] at hwpi'
   609    rw [hd ρ hs hwta hwpi'.1] at hmema
   610    refine ⟨WellDenoted_app_of m.M φ hwf hwa hwpi hmemf hmema,
   611      (WellDenoted_inst0 m.M φ hwa).mpr (hwpi'.2.1 _ hmema), ?_⟩
   612    rw [interp_app, interp_inst0]
   613    rw [interp_pi] at hmemf
   614    exact app_mem_piR hmemf hmema hwpi'.2.2

   138  theorem refl_sound {Γ : List Expr} {e : Expr} : RedSem m φ Γ e e :=

   141  theorem trans_sound {Γ : List Expr} {e₁ e₂ e₃ : Expr}
   142      (h₁ : RedSem m φ Γ e₁ e₂) (h₂ : RedSem m φ Γ e₂ e₃) : RedSem m φ Γ e₁ e₃ := by
   143    intro ρ hs hw
   144    obtain ⟨hw₁, he₁⟩ := h₁ ρ hs hw
   145    obtain ⟨hw₂, he₂⟩ := h₂ ρ hs hw₁
   146    exact ⟨hw₂, he₁.trans he₂⟩

   148  theorem appFn_sound {Γ : List Expr} {f f' a : Expr} (h : RedSem m φ Γ f f') :
   149      RedSem m φ Γ (Expr.app f a) (Expr.app f' a) := by
   150    intro ρ hs hw
   151    rw [WellDenoted_app] at hw
   152    obtain ⟨hf, ha, p, A, B, hslot, hmem, hB⟩ := hw
   153    obtain ⟨hf', he⟩ := h ρ hs hf
   154    refine ⟨?_, by simp [he]⟩
   155    rw [WellDenoted_app]
   156    exact ⟨hf', ha, p, A, B, he ▸ hslot, hmem, hB⟩

   383  theorem pi_sound {Γ : List Expr} {A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ : Expr} {pw : PropWhen}
   384      (hA : DefEqSem m φ Γ A₁ A₂) (hB : DefEqSem m φ (A₂ :: Γ) B₁ B₂) :
   385      DefEqSem m φ Γ (Expr.pi A₁ pw B₁) (Expr.pi A₂ pw B₂) := by
   386    intro ρ hs h₁ h₂
   387    rw [WellDenoted_pi] at h₁ h₂
   388    have heA := hA ρ hs h₁.1 h₂.1
   389    simp only [interp_pi]
   390    rw [heA]
   391    apply piR_congr
   392    intro x hx
   393    have hx₁ : x ∈ˢ interp m.M φ ρ A₁ := by rw [heA]; exact hx
   394    exact hB (cons x ρ) ((Sat_cons m.M φ).mpr ⟨hs, h₂.1, hx⟩) (h₁.2.1 x hx₁) (h₂.2.1 x hx)

   407    exact hb (cons x ρ) ((Sat_cons m.M φ).mpr ⟨hs, h₂.1, hx⟩) (h₁.2.1 x hx₁) (h₂.2.1 x hx)

== whitepaper/Fragment/Rules.lean#L161-L175
   161  **There is no `trans` rule, deliberately** (`Rel.lean:310-333`, task
   162  #309).  The relation is the checker's verdict on two terms that are
   163  well-formed *together*, a fact no rule states because well-formedness
   164  is semantic (`WellDenoted`) and may not enter this inductive.  Every
   165  rule respects one discipline instead: **the subject of each `DefEq`
   166  premise is a subterm of the conclusion or is produced by a `Red` or
   167  `Infer` premise** (a reduct, an inferred type), so the soundness proof
   168  always has the premise's terms — and their invariant — in hand.  A
   169  `trans` rule is the unique rule that would break it: its middle term
   170  comes from nowhere, so nothing supplies its invariant, and the
   171  induction has nothing to apply the hypothesis to.  In the real checker
   172  the rule is not merely unprovable but unsound (`fvar`s carry
   173  annotations `DefEq.fvar` does not compare while `DefEq.proofFast`
   174  reads; `trans` lets the two meet).  The one sound chaining is "reduce,
   175  then continue": `redL`. -/

== ConLeche/Rules/Rel.lean#L310-L333
   310  /-- **Definitional equality**: the verdict `true` of `isDefEq`.
   311  
   312  **There is no `trans` rule, deliberately, and none can be added**
   313  (task #309, the experiment recorded in DESIGN.md).  The relation is
   314  not an equivalence on terms: it is the checker's verdict, and the
   315  checker only ever compares terms that are well-formed *together* — a
   316  fact the rules never state, because well-formedness (scoping, the
   317  readability of annotations, the grading of the reading) is semantic
   318  and may not enter this inductive.  Every rule respects one syntactic
   319  discipline instead: **the subject of each `DefEq` premise is either a
   320  subterm of the conclusion or is produced by an existence-form `Red` /
   321  `Infer` premise** (a reduct, an inferred type), so the soundness proof
   322  (`ConLeche/Model/Rules/Sound.lean`) always has the premise's terms in
   323  hand.  `trans` is the unique rule that would break it: its middle
   324  term comes from nowhere, and with it two rules that are each sound
   325  alone meet — `fvar` compares free variables by index only (their
   326  annotations are not compared, as the checker does not), while
   327  `proofFast` *reads* an annotation to decide "definitely a proof" —
   328  and derive `DefEq env d (.fvar i ty) (.fvar i' ty')` for every
   329  `i`, `i'`, which no model satisfies.  The recursive-structure rules
   330  (`redL`, `natSucc`, `eta`, `structUnit`) are therefore not a
   331  proof-engineering convenience but what keeps the relation sound; the
   332  one chaining that is sound, "reduce, then continue", is `redL`, and
   333  its right-hand and δ variants are derived in `Derived.lean`. -/
